about.title: About PSPBA
about.subtitle: Strengthening peace and resilience across Plateau State
about.fallback_text: Plateau State Peacebuilding Agency (PSPBA) works to strengthen peace and resilience across Plateau State and its 17 Local Government Areas.
about.content_updating: Content is being updated. Check back soon.
about.mission_text: To build sustainable peace in Plateau State through inclusive dialogue, conflict prevention, and community resilience.
about.vision_text: A united, stable, and inclusive Plateau at peace with itself and the rest of the world.
about.story_p1: The Plateau State Peacebuilding Agency (PSPBA) was established by the Plateau State Government to coordinate and strengthen peacebuilding efforts across the state. We work in all 17 Local Government Areas (LGAs), partnering with communities, traditional institutions, civil society, and government to prevent conflict, resolve tensions, and build lasting peace.
about.story_p2: Our programmes focus on inclusive dialogue, early warning and response, policy advocacy, research, and community-led peace initiatives. PSPBA serves as a hub for knowledge, coordination, and support—enabling sustainable peace that benefits every citizen of Plateau State.
about.inclusivity_desc: We engage all stakeholders—communities, government, traditional institutions—in meaningful participation.
about.integrity_desc: We operate with transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct in all our programmes.
about.collaboration_desc: We work with partners across sectors to amplify impact and avoid duplication.
about.evidence_based_desc: Our decisions are informed by data, research, and lessons from the field.
about.community_ownership_desc: Communities lead and own peace initiatives; we support and facilitate.
about.gender_sensitivity_desc: We mainstream gender perspectives and promote women's participation in peace processes.
about.community_dialogue_desc: Facilitating inter-communal and intra-communal dialogue across the 17 LGAs to build trust and understanding.
about.early_warning_desc: Monitoring tensions and deploying rapid response to prevent escalation of conflicts.
about.policy_advocacy_desc: Engaging government and stakeholders to advance peace-responsive policies and programmes.
about.research_learning_desc: Generating evidence and sharing best practices to strengthen peacebuilding practice.
about.get_involved_text: Join us in building sustainable peace across Plateau State. Reach out or apply to become a peace actor.

our_work.title: Our Work
our_work.subtitle: Building sustainable peace across Plateau State's 17 Local Government Areas
our_work.overview_p1: The Plateau State Peacebuilding Agency (PSPBA) operates across all 17 Local Government Areas of Plateau State. Through the SPRiNG programme and community-level partnerships, PSPBA leads coordinated efforts in conflict prevention, mediation, early warning and response, youth and women empowerment, psychosocial support, and evidence-based research.
our_work.community_dialogue_desc: Facilitating inter-communal and intra-communal dialogue sessions across all 17 LGAs, training mediators, and building trust between communities.
our_work.early_warning_desc: Operating early warning mechanisms, training community monitors, and deploying rapid response to prevent escalation of conflicts.
our_work.youth_women_desc: Engaging young people and women as peace champions through leadership training, mentorship, and advocacy programmes.
our_work.research_desc: Generating evidence, publishing research, monitoring conflict trends, and sharing best practices across the peacebuilding sector.
our_work.policy_desc: Engaging government, traditional institutions, and civil society to advance peace-responsive policies and institutional reform.
our_work.psychosocial_desc: Providing trauma healing, psychosocial support, and reconciliation programmes for affected communities.
our_work.geographic_desc: PSPBA works across all 17 Local Government Areas of Plateau State
our_work.partner_text: We welcome partnerships with international and local organizations, civil society groups, government agencies, and community-based organizations to strengthen peace across Plateau State.
